global_attrs.title: Porwollik et al. 2019 tillage data
global_attrs.institution: Potsdam Institute for Climate Impact Research (PIK)
global_attrs.summary: Tillage data from Porwollik et al. 2019, assuming conventional tillage everywhere prior to 1974

long_name: Historical binary tillage practice application value for each cell (written as integer 0/1 for no/yes). 1973 has all cells set to 1, which can be applied for all years before 1973 with tillage everywhere as a spinup. If no tillage for these years is needed, use other dataset.
